You’re Invited: Trail building insights from the Colorado Rockies.
Join us for a Trailmakers Hui featuring Paul Talley, Executive Director of the Colorado Trail Foundation, as he shares experiences working with volunteers to build and maintain trails in the USA. colorado-trail.lilregie.com
